main_body: steampunk street lamp / lantern post with rounded cap, glowing lantern housing, thin pole, and rounded base
top_band: rounded grey-blue cap top surface with brass finial (rows 1-7) and elliptical grey-blue base top surface (rows 36-41)
evidence: The lamp has a clear rounded 3/4 cap at the top (rows 1-7) with a brass finial in the middle, an undercut/eave shadow at rows 8-10 overhanging the recessed lantern glass (rows 11-15), a collar at 28-30, and a foreshortened elliptical base top surface at rows 36-41 above a darker front rim (rows 42-44).

style.evidence: The grey metal cap and base have large flat fills (e.g. a 7x4 block of identical mid-grey on the cap and a 9x5 block on the base) with no surface grain or specular detail, surrounded by a heavy near-black outline (#181820). Compared to the Beodeul reference props, the shading is blocky and sticker-like with low colour density.
